headline: Red Sox heartbreaker in Tampa as the postseason path narrows
morning_brew: I am still trying to wrap my head around last night, because blowing a game like that when Brayan Bello is absolutely dealing is pure torture. Bello was lights out for eight full innings, punching out eleven Rays and doing everything in his power to keep us in the hunt. When you get that kind of performance in the middle of a stretch run, you expect the bats to do the bare minimum, but we just could not find a way to break it open.

Watching Garrett Whitlock come on in the ninth and surrender the lead felt like a massive punch to the gut. I know the bullpen has had its shaky moments, but that one felt like a total collapse just as we were trying to build some cushion in the wild card race. It is a miserable way to drop a game, especially when you realize how much weight every single out carries right now.

We have to shake it off and get back on the field this afternoon in Tampa to salvage something from this weekend. I am not gonna sit here and act like I am not worried, because the math is getting tighter and my patience for late-inning drama is officially at zero. Hopefully we can reset, play some clean baseball, and get a win before we head back to the Hub for a massive homestand.
